'''Junia Tavrak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
During the Empire's [[Battle of Corellia|invasion]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Tavrak ordered [[Randun Ard]] and his squad of mercenaries to eliminate a group of rebelling [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officers. However, when all except Randun were killed in an ambush, Junia tasked an Imperial team to stop the attackers despite Randun's protest.
